data.key: Desert Raider ~ Sun at Your Back
data.name: Sun at Your Back
data.description: A desert raider can use the reflected light of the blinding sun to conceal her presence. A desert raider in bright light can attempt Stealth checks without cover or concealment but takes a -5 penalty on her check. The desert raider cannot use this ability to hide from creatures immune to the blinded or dazzled conditions.
